title: Enforcing Symmetries on Pre-trained ML Models for Physics
abstract: arXiv:2611.08992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc group averaging (or test-time augmentation) is a simple way to impose symmetry on a trained predictor without changing its architecture or retraining it. For finite and compact groups, averaging over a normalized Haar measure on the group gives the Reynolds operator: a canonical projection onto invariant or equivariant predictors with known non-increasing risk guarantees under certain assumptions. This paper provides numerical experiments on physics emulation models that demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in this setting. We then extend this framework to non-compact group symmetries. For non-compact groups, the Haar measure cannot be normalized, so group averaging cannot be defined in the same way. translated_title: 在物理领域的预训练机器学习模型上强制实施对称性
translated_abstract: 事后群平均（或测试时增强）是一种简单的方法，可以在不改变已训练预测器的架构或重新训练的情况下对其施加对称性。对于有限群和紧致群，通过对群上归一化的哈尔测度进行平均可以得到雷诺兹算子：一个到不变或等变预测器的规范投影，在某些假设下具有已知的风险不增保证。本文在物理仿真模型上进行了数值实验，证明了该方法在这种场景下的有效性。随后，我们将该框架扩展到非紧致群对称性。对于非紧致群，哈尔测度无法归一化，因此无法以相同的方式定义群平均。我们用三种替代方案来取代它：Weyl幺正技巧（需要对空间进行复化并扩展预测器）、数据依赖的正交投影（涉及一个非平凡的优化过程）……
tldr: 本文将事后群平均方法扩展应用于预训练的物理机器学习模型以强制实施对称性，并针对非紧致群提出了三种替代方案（包括Weyl幺正技巧和数据依赖的正交投影），且不改变模型架构或需要重新训练。
en_tdlr: This paper extends post-hoc group averaging to enforce symmetries on pre-trained ML models for physics, and proposes three alternatives—including the Weyl unitary trick and a data-dependent orthogonal projection—to handle non-compact group symmetries without changing the architecture or retraining.
